card.name: Numbers and units in dosing text
card.fires_on: Small pieces inside dosing and lab-method phrases: the % after a concentration, the number 7 in a days-off schedule, a space before a second number, and 'with' after 'liquid chromatography'.

modes.label: Percent after concentration
modes.description: The % sign right after a number giving a solution strength.
modes.example: to final volume with 5<<%>> Dextrose Injection, USP.)

modes.label: Number or space in schedules
modes.description: A number or space inside a dose or duration range, such as days off therapy or minutes.
modes.example: for 14 consecutive days followed by <<7>> days off therapy, in 21

modes.label: With after chromatography
modes.description: The word 'with' linking liquid chromatography to its detection method.
modes.example: urinary normetanephrine by liquid chromatography<< with>> electrochemical detection
